_about: Approved joins. cardinality is read from the 'from' side: N:1 = many from-rows per to-row (to side unique); 1:1 / 1:0..1 = both sides unique. Every relationship is re-checked live (orphans, uniqueness) by metadata/verify_metadata.py. Joins not listed here are rejected by the SQL validator; facts that share a parent (e.g. contracts and financing via project_id) must be pre-aggregated to the shared key before joining.
